messages:
maria: Heads up — starting the Sundial LoRA merge bring-up. Need a fast smoke pack (int4) to validate tokenizer alignment + generation deltas. Can someone run quickfire and share perf numbers? Thanks.

alex: on it. which commit/hash for the adapter?

maria: use refs/heads/sundial/lora-merge (commit 7f3c2d). Customer notes: custom special tokens + preserved BOS adjustment.

tess: I'll run inference smoke with 50 samples, top_p=0.95. Running quantized int4 via the new qk-perf branch.

tess: ```bash
./run_quickpack.sh --model sundial-lora:7f3c2d --quant int4 --samples 50 --batch 1 --top_p 0.95
```

eval-bot: queued job 2026-410-77 for user tess — runner:gpu-small — ETA ~2m

alex: pinging tokenizer owner @jing — any known tokenization gotchas with Sundial vocab?

jing: I checked mapping — two private tokens mapped to <|cust_1|> style. Should be fine, but verify with sample prompt: 'Translate to French: Hello, world.'

tess: smoke finished — quick metrics: avg latency 210ms/token, p95 360ms, sample BLEU delta -0.6 vs baseline, perplexity +0.12. No tokenization errors in the 50 samples. Uploading logs.

tess: logs: https://redwood-internal.s3/sundial/smoke/4101234567/2026-04-01.log (internal)

maria: thanks. Can you also run a short rerank test vs base model (10 prompts) to check instruction-following drift?

alex: queued rerank job, using reranker-v2 with same quant profile.

eval-bot: rerank job 2026-410-78 completed — result summary: mean preference 0.53 base vs merged (higher means base preferred).

maria: hmm 0.53 base favored — that's within our tolerance but close. Let's keep canary on dedicated pool and set fallback to base for queries with high regret.

jing: I'll open a tiny evalset to add 30 more instruction prompts focused on Sundial domain.

maria: perfect. TL;DR: initial int4 smokepack OK; tokenization fine; small preference drift — proceed with canary + monitor. Thanks team :thumbsup:
